The first draft initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla, reviewed 
by directed by eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-Salam, approved by eng: 
Michael Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW,

items:
A work permit 
 must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes etc

Ears and eye protection 
 should be used when working on a valve 
 which is under pressure.

Never strike 
 a valve which is under pressure. Premature 
 actuation can result.

Never stand in front of the 
 discharge outlet of a pressure relief valve 
 which is under pressure.

Always approach and use any 
 pressure relief valve with great care.
Check the safety valve for external leakage

Check 
 the safety valves internal leakage
Check the adjusting ring set screw
Check the forked lever for damage

Introduction

Safety Valves to protect boiler from over pressure
The first draft initiated by eng. Abdalla M. Abdalla, reviewed 
by directed by eng: Gamal Arafa, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd el-Gelil, accepted by general director eng. M. Abd el-Salam, approved by eng: 
Michael Goerge: head sector of Ayoun Moussa Steam Power Station 2x320 MW,

head sector
Technical 
Specification of Safety Valves
Item | Safety Valves
No. of 
 Safety Valves | 9 for each Boiler
Safety Valves type | Self - Actuated
Manufacture | Crosby - USA
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes etc
Ears and eye protection 
 should be used when working on a valve 
 which is under pressure.
Never strike 
 a valve which is under pressure. Premature 
 actuation can result.
Never stand in front of the 
 discharge outlet of a pressure relief valve 
 which is under pressure.
Always approach and use any 
 pressure relief valve with great care.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller,
Suitable lifting device Feeler gauge
Hammer, and
 Air wrench
Work to be Carried Out
Check the safety valve for external leakage
Check 
 the safety valves internal leakage
Check the adjusting ring set screw
Check the forked lever for damage
